correctness.rationale: Exact local necessity and sufficiency of different coloured neighbours at every zero; exhaustive decomposition by isolated zeros; forest edge constraints give \(2^{n-2k}\) except alternating cycles, whose two-colourability depends on n mod 4. Counts of independent zero positions are exact, every family disjoint. Transfer identities and minimum coefficients follow algebraically. Direct brute force checked all 531426 three-label maps in specified finite orders; a separate 100-order recurrence comparison corroborates, without replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Complete closed cardinality distributions are natural invariants for the singleton two-rainbow model on foundational graph families, motivated by modern work that currently identifies only the minimum. The new exact counts of minimizers change from constant (four-divisible) to quadratic (two mod four) to linear (odd), a boundary compatibility effect invisible in the known minimum value. The common path/cycle proof and rational generating functions make these coefficients structurally interpretable and reusable.
